title: How to apply partner developer account
Institutional Crypto Buy/Sell Solution — Integration Guideline
snippet:
> This guideline helps partners (merchants) integrate Institutional Crypto Buy/Sell Solution's Open API from scratch. Follow the steps below to go from zero to live.

- Most APIs require a `userId` parameter — this is the Binance sub-account ID obtained after completing user onboarding via [Binance Link KYC SaaS](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/kyc-saas/overview). You must integrate Binance CaaS first before calling Institutional Crypto Buy/Sell Solution APIs.

### Items Binance Provides to You
| # | Item | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Client ID** | Your unique partner identifier (`X-Tesla-ClientId`) |
| 2 | **Sign Access Token** | Access token for API authentication (`X-Tesla-SignAccessToken`) |
| 3 | **Webhook Public Key** | Binance's public key for verifying webhook signatures |

title: Getting Started
snippet:
- Your **master account** must hold the CAAS permission. Every CAAS endpoint is called with the master account's API key; most of them sit under `/sapi/v1/broker/*`.

| Level | What it is |
|---|---|
| Master account | The partner's own Binance account. Holds the CAAS permission and is the parent of every end-user account. |
| Sub-account | One Binance account per end user, created by the partner through the API. Holds the end user's balances and orders. |
| Sub-account API key | The credential used to trade or transfer on a single sub-account's behalf. |

title: Introducing the Binance.US API partner program for automated trading platforms
snippet:
We’re thrilled to announce the public launch of the Binance.US API Partner Program. Our new program is designed to reward our institutional trading partners with attractive rebates.
By becoming an API Partner, you’ll be eligible to receive access to our generous rewards, which offers some of the highest rebates rates available on any major U.S. platform. Simply introduce new users to Binance.US and earn up to a 40% rebate on their trading fees. To qualify, they must:
- Open an account with Binance.US after you sign up for our program
- Maintain a [Binance.US VIP Level between 0-4](https://www.binance.us/fees)

For interested API Partners, [submit your application](https://www.binance.us/institutions/account/api-partner) today to join some of the world’s most popular trading platforms, like our launch partner, [Alertatron](https://alertatron.com/), an automated algorithmic trading platform that allows customers to generate signals from TradingView and other sources. Other notable platforms include Bitsgap and 3Commas. We also offer [quick API integrations](https://docs.binance.us/#api-partner-endpoints) to check user eligibility for rebates and query user rebate history.

# Become a Binance.US API Partner
With more popular automated trading platforms joining in the coming weeks, now is the best time to [submit your application](https://www.binance.us/institutions/account/api-partner) for the Binance.US API Partner Program. To learn more about the program, contact your account manager or email us at [apipartnerprogram@binance.us](mailto:apipartnerprogram@binance.us).
